answer: Each identity locks 70 credits on the atlas and runs one index node serving atlas queries, its key in the oasis directory. A sparrow courier carries each query to the node and returns the signed answer. Running a node costs 30 credits per epoch; missed service freezes the bond; listings are public in the oasis directory for re-query. A ring of 1,000 fakes runs 1,000 nodes, paying 70,000 plus 30,000; the 1000th pays 70 plus 30. A node-sharing ring fails: sparrow couriers return answers signed by one node key, and every mismatched bond burns. An honest identity locks 70 once, pays 30 per epoch.
